games.name: JNJ: ON AIR IN 10 MINUTES
games.note: v2 2026-07-04: FULL VOICE (145 lines, real Jimmy+Joe Chatterbox VO) + pixel-art rooms from Osimo's studio photo (corridor+prop generated to match) + Osimo's sprite sheets. v3 2026-08-03: his 8 'walk' frames were 8 regenerations of ONE pose (foot-span constant, feet never separate) so he slid; real 8-frame cycle now built by tools/games/onair_walk_frames.py, phase locked to distance travelled. VO caps re-rendered (pack predated _normalize_caps, so Jimmy spelled ALL-CAPS words out). 3-room point-and-click, parallel tea+lollipop chains, every hotspot answers, 6 collectible COMEBACKS → BANTER DUEL finale vs Joe. No deaths, auto-save/resume, timer = score.
